name: Cultural Landscape of Khinalig People and “Köç Yolu” Transhumance Route
description: High in the Greater Caucasus of northern Azerbaijan, Khinalig is a remote mountain village whose semi-nomadic people still move their flocks seasonally. Each year they follow the 200-kilometre Köç Yolu, or "Migration Route," between summer pastures and terraced fields in the peaks and winter grazing on the central lowland plains. Along the way you can see old camping sites, mosques and mausoleums.
